title: A Troublesome Faith
text: “Well… a world where you can just bring people back to life left and right is pretty rare. Most of the time, it’s a miracle or something like that… though I have seen worlds where, if you’re following a predetermined scenario, you’re allowed to keep going until you achieve your goal.”
“A scenario, you say?”
“Some people call it fate. Motoyasu, maybe you have some idea what I’m talking about?”
Ark’s words got me thinking. Hmm… even when you put it that way, it doesn’t really click with me.

“It’s not just a matter of the soul—they’ve also made it so the body can’t last very long… It’s truly awful. Those fools who act like they’re all-powerful… it makes me sick. Their methods aren’t exactly subtle, are they?”
“I agree.”
“Lie down here for a moment,” Ho-kun instructs the Queen to lie down. The Queen does as she’s told and lies down on the examination table.
“It’ll burn a little, but try to bear with it. I’ll keep the pain to a minimum, but you’ll have to tough it out.”
Ho-kun held up his index finger like a wing and released a flame from its tip. The flame darted around the Queen, rained down on her body, and began to burn.
“Kuh… uuuuugh…”

The Queen’s face contorted in agony, but Trash and her Finacée each took one of her hands and immediately smiled reassuringly. There was a sizzling sound and smell as if something were burning, but the unpleasant odor gradually faded away.
“All right. The procedure is complete. With this… you’ll be able to live at least as long as your husband.”
“Ah, thank you so much.”
The Queen thanked Ho-kun while checking how she was feeling. Since there’s a considerable age gap between Trash and the Queen, her lifespan has been significantly shortened.
“I feel so much better than before… I didn’t even realize it. That heavy feeling in my body is gone.”
“Well, you were starting to rot away little by little. It must be painful, especially if you’re already rotten to the core. Anyway, the problem’s solved now.”
The Queen’s complexion seemed to have improved slightly.
“Is this okay?”
“Yeah. You’ve still got great skills, as always.”
“You won’t get anything out of me just by complimenting me. Seriously… I really wanted to burn the ringleaders who pulled this stunt myself.”
Ho-kun grumbled to Ark.
“…If there are others like that, I want to take care of them quickly, so let’s hurry.”
“There are others, too. Raphtalia, bring that old hag over here.”
“I know who you mean, but Naofumi-sama, please at least remember her name.”
My father specifically requested the old woman from the Hengen Muso Style and had Ho-kun treat her.
“Ho-kun, you’re amazing! So cool! You’re awesome!”
“I’m not the least bit happy to be cheered on by Motoyasu-kun’s booming voice.”
“Bird—awesome!”
“Awesome!”
Ark and my father are following my lead. We’re all in this together!
“You don’t have to jump on the bandwagon there either! Seriously! You two always pick the same things to piggyback on…”
“You’re actually pulling off some competent moves, yet you’re so low-key.”
“It was such a cringeworthy scene that I couldn’t even bring myself to act excited. I was seriously debating whether to cut my vacation short just to go vent my frustration by roasting some fool!”
Apparently, it was an unpleasant scene for Ho-kun.
“Good work, Ho-kun. As a thank you, I’ll groom you.”
“No, why? It’s not a thank you—you just want to groom me, don’t you!”
“That’s not true at all.”
Sniffing Ho-kun’s scent, I see. And so, thanks to Ho-kun, the Queen and the old woman of the Hengen Muso Style were able to resolve the problem caused by the Crimson Swine itself.
“Anyway, you really helped me out in more ways than one. So, if you guys are in the mood to cause some chaos, I’ve got just the thing. Want to join in?”
“What? Is something going on?”
“I’ve got a few things piling up right now. Give me about an hour. Until then, I’d like everyone to take it easy—including Motoyasu.”
“Roger that!”
“Okayyyy. Well then, I’m gonna go do my own thing.”
With that, Ho-kun heads off, so I follow him.
“Motoyasu-kun, you look just like a baby bird following that bird over there.”
“Come on, give me a break!”

Ho-kun took off at a light jog, so I chased after him. Wait up, Ho-kun! An hour later, I went to the village square—the meeting spot—after hearing that my Father had called for me. There he was, waiting with my Big Sister and my Big Sister’s older sister.
“Did you call for me?”
“Ah, Motoyasu, you’re coming too. You’re the right person for the job.”
Wow, a direct request from my Father. I swear I’ll definitely accomplish this mission.
“You’ve got a favor to ask of me, don’t you? If it’s an order from my Father, I’ll do anything.”
“Naofumi-sama, please be careful how you phrase things.”
“I know.”
“Oh my—Motoyasu-chan really is such a hard worker, isn’t he?”
Big Sister’s older sister is laughing heartily.

“A little while ago, reports started pouring in from Trash, Ren, and several other countries about suspected reincarnated individuals. Trash says they’ll deal with them as soon as they’re identified, but they asked us to split up and investigate.”
“So, I just need to destroy them the moment I encounter them, right?”
I feel like my Father is looking at me with a somewhat grim expression, but I’m sure it’s just my imagination.
“…Well, as long as Tori’s here, we’ll be fine, right? I’ll leave Ark, Ho, and Motoyasu to you.”
“I kind of feel like they’re dumping the most troublesome people on me.”
“I guess I’d be willing to do it if asked, but it’s surprising they’d entrust this to us newbies.”
“You guys are starting to get the hang of it, aren’t you? Wiping out that guy’s remnants falls under your jurisdiction, right?”
“Well, yeah. We’ve got a pretty good grasp of the basics. Tori, I’ll leave the leadership to you, Motoyasu-kun.”
“Yeah, yeah. Well, if it gets seriously troublesome, I’ll probably just leave it to the cat.”
And so, I was assigned to Ho-kun’s group. Kuu and the others are watching from a distance. It’s my Father’s order, so I guess there’s nothing I can do about it.
“The Tri-Color Filolials, as an idol group, are to scout out reincarnated individuals in a certain region. If you want to go with Motoyasu, I’ll give you permission.”
“Ugh…”
“To make personnel decisions like this while knowing how Marin and the others feel—”
“That’s so mean!”
“If you’re going to complain, take it up with Motoyasu, who’s always hanging around Ho.”

I just want to help the lonely Ho-kun get along with the Filolial-sama. In fact, thanks to my mediation, Filolial-sama are gradually getting along better with Ho-kun. It’s just that Ku and the others aren’t used to it yet. By the way, it seems that Filo-tan also talks with Ho-kun from time to time.
“So where are we supposed to go?”

“Ah, well, apparently there are survivors of a group in the countryside who used to worship that crappy goddess… They abandoned their faith to survive and built a settlement, but I hear things are starting to get restless there. Apparently, there’s a ringleader. For now, start with a reconnaissance mission, and if they’re up to no good, take them out.”
In other words, that means it’s okay for me to show Ho and the others just how awesome I am. Leave it to me!

“Honestly, I’d rather leave this sort of thing to Itsuki, but he’s out on a mission too. I’m heading out with Raphtalia and the others to investigate another reincarnated person, so I’ll leave it to you.”
“It’s amazing they’ve managed to stick around this long.”

After witnessing the Crimson Swine—the very entity that tried to destroy the world—the pathetic state of the reincarnated beings, and Father’s heroic deeds, the fact that they’re still lying low and biding their time goes beyond just being exasperating—it’s actually impressive.
“Ah… the frequency of these appearances does seem unnatural. I thought we’d cleared them out once… but given the circumstances, there might be something going on.”
“Yeah. There are some spots that are a bit out of sight, too.”

It’s been quite a while since we defeated the Crimson Swine itself and dealt with the straggling reincarnated survivors that appeared here and there. They’ve occasionally shown up to cause trouble, but it seems their numbers are actually increasing. Still, those guys are just unlucky. After all, I’m the one heading out to deal with them. This is the perfect opportunity to show Ho-kun just how heroic I can be.

“Well… faith isn’t something so simplistic that brainwashing just disappears once you defeat the object of that faith. If anything, they become saint-like, and their unity only grows stronger. Or perhaps they’ll replace their thoughts with a convenient delusion—like claiming the one they defeated was a fake.”

Ark muttered with a hint of exasperation. It seems he has a deep understanding of these matters. He asked, “Suppose the mentor you admire from the bottom of your heart—the one who saved you from misfortune—had their dignity stripped away and was then brutally murdered. What would you do?” I suppose that just goes to show how complicated the human heart can be. But… crushing the head of the very object of their worship…
“Well then, shall we get going?”
“Ooh, let’s do it!”
And so, we set off to destroy that suspicious group of people who were apparently worshiping the Crimson Swine itself.
